## WF1 - Case intake (plan section 17)

Honesty note (matches desk/api.py's own module docstring): POST /cases currently wraps a **frozen corpus case** under corpus/cases/, not a live customer-supplied artifact bundle -- desk/intake/ (HAR/XML upload parsing) does not exist yet. This webhook body is therefore `{ "corpus_case": "<name>" }`, not a raw bundle. When desk/intake/ is built, only the HTTP Request node's JSON body needs to change; everything downstream of it (the disposition Switch, the sub-workflow calls) is already correct for either shape.

See n8n/README.md for what this workflow does and does not do.

awaiting_evidence needs no action here. WF3 (n8n/wf3-evidence-chase.json) polls `GET /cases?state=awaiting_evidence` on its own 4-hour schedule and will pick this case up -- chaining it from WF1 too would just race WF3's own filter-by-age logic.

parameters.content: 'extra' catches any disposition this Switch does not explicitly branch on -- including 'auto', which desk/policy/rules.py's DISPOSITIONS enum defines but its rule table (_decide_base_disposition) structurally never returns (0 of 51 corpus labels use it either, confirmed 2026-08-17 -- see rules.py's own module docstring). This is a real, currently-unreachable branch, kept because the policy vocabulary allows it and a future rule-table version could legitimately emit it; it is not dead code masquerading as coverage. Route here is a NoOp -- nothing to do until that day.
